title: Box Condition Amounts for Returned Footwear
content:
The Marlowe & Finch returns centre records a box condition for every returned footwear unit. On a Returns & Exchanges return, the box condition sets the box amount charged per pair on a footwear line that came back without its original box, in a damaged box or in a box used as the shipping carton.

## Lines charged

A shoebox fee is charged on each footwear line whose inspection entries record the box condition "original box damaged or used as shipper" or "no original box"; the units charged are the units on those entries. A line whose box came back intact carries none.

## Box amount

| Box condition recorded at inspection | Pair's booked unit price | Box amount per pair |
|---|---|---|
| Original box damaged or used as the shipping carton | Any | 5.00 USD |
| No original box | Below 75 USD | 6.00 USD |
| No original box | 75 USD or more | The return type's missing box fee |

## Both sides of the price threshold (missing box)

| Booked unit price | Box amount |
|---|---|
| 74.99 | 6.00 |
| 75.00 | The return type's missing box fee |

Example (hypothetical): two pairs of ankle boots booked at 129.00 came back in their original boxes, which had been taped up and used as the shipping carton: the box amount is 5.00 per pair.
